user_question: Optional scope preference asked; this artifact does not record approval or silently replace existing whole-utterance policy.
task_question: Does the audio express a role of the defined type that contributes to a requested operation, query, constraint, target description, or explicitly requested message content?
logic: exists expression: matches_type_definition AND satisfies_presence_policy AND relevant_to_any_expressed_request

axes.type_identity: role under supplied definition, not lexical entity lookup
axes.relevance: relation to requested task; not supplied gold intent
axes.commitment: affirmed, excluded, corrected, conditional or cancelled value is separate from type presence

scope_rules: All expressed requests are considered; do not choose relevance by the single native Final label.
Inspect the complete audio to establish relevance; a past tense or negation token never decides relevance alone.
Quoted content explicitly requested for posting or sending is part of the task; types still require their own role evidence.
Excluded values, corrections and cancelled targets can express types; this task does not output accepted slot values or executable states.
An explicit conditional request remains a request; unavailable external condition truth must not be invented.
Unknown relevance or unresolved type precedence masks supervision; it is not a negative.
A type match plus relevance is not a gold intent-to-slot instance binding; B_bound requires independent binding truth.
Atomic S negatives require complete inspection for the configured type/policy/scope; native omission is insufficient.

changes_required: Version scope and align all 55 definition cards; do not overwrite pinned draft.
Re-review evidence whose policy hash changes; no automatic inheritance of prior truth.
Audit 89 boundary rules and explicit-filler exceptions independently of relevance.
Rebuild annotation-workpack with new identity before bulk annotation; retain native labels.
Freeze selection annotation under the same policy after learning-side design; no test-driven scope changes.

real_scope_examples.reference: let's play never have i ever
real_scope_examples.rationale: never occurs inside the game title and is not request negation.
yesterday identifies the list to remove; it is not the execution date.

real_scope_examples.reference: define love without invoking the term love
real_scope_examples.rationale: love is the object of definition even with a constraint on wording.

real_scope_examples.reference: download the latest folk songs having rating of four star or above and play all without shuffle
real_scope_examples.rationale: without shuffle specifies the requested playback mode; type presence does not mean shuffle is enabled.

real_scope_examples.reference: play music of kate perry without shuffle
real_scope_examples.rationale: without shuffle supplies a playback-setting constraint.

real_scope_examples.reference: post that i am going to mcdonalds at manhattan
real_scope_examples.rationale: Manhattan is inside the explicitly requested post content; payload is part of the requested task.

real_scope_examples.reference: post that i am going to walmart for shopping
real_scope_examples.rationale: Walmart is inside the requested post content, not an unrelated background mention.

real_scope_examples.reference: can you update my facebook profile picture to the image i took from google office yesterday
real_scope_examples.rationale: yesterday identifies the photo to use for the requested profile update.

real_scope_examples.reference: can you tweet for me to amazon services for not delivering my product on time
real_scope_examples.rationale: Amazon services is the complaint target; not delivering does not negate its identity.

real_scope_examples.rationale: last night constrains the email query.

real_scope_examples.reference: play the playlist we were listening last night

The mode is explicitly constrained; do not interpret presence as enablement.

synthetic_scope_examples.audio_meaning_text: I met Susan yesterday. What is two plus two?
synthetic_scope_examples.rationale: Susan is unrelated background to the requested calculation.

synthetic_scope_examples.audio_meaning_text: Tell Susan what two plus two is.

synthetic_scope_examples.rationale: A cancellation target is still a task object.

synthetic_scope_examples.audio_meaning_text: Find a flight to Rome, not Paris.

Explicit-filler time requires a temporal expression; asking for a value does not provide one.
